summary: Mixed day driven by retail sector dynamics and corporate governance disputes. UPI merchant costs threaten payment acceptance habits, while Tata Trusts prepares court challenge to Tata Sons chairmanship reappointment.

bullets.text: Tata Trusts preparing to challenge Tata Sons' reappointment of N Chandrasekaran as chairman, likely escalating to NCLT or Bombay High Court.
Small retailers may shift to cash and bank transfers for transactions above Rs 2,000 to avoid new UPI MDR costs.
Four of six mega Indian IPOs (Rs 10,000 crore+) trading below issue price, signaling disappointing investor returns.
Motilal Oswal upgrades JSW Cement to Buy from Neutral, citing strong volume growth and North India expansion.
Chinese regulators scrutinizing humanoid robot IPO valuations, slowing rush of listings as hype outpaces reality.
